title: Putting cards on display so they sell
target: How to use the card displays in TCG Card Shop Simulator, given that the game ships displays for a table, for a wall and an electronic version, with their own fronts and price tags.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Floor or wall space in the shop
A price decided before the card goes in

steps.do: Pick the display shape before placing anything.
steps.because: the build ships card displays for a table, for a wall and an electronic one (CardDisplayTable, CardDisplayWall, CardDisplayElectronic_Mesh)

steps.do: Use the wall versions when floor space is short.
steps.because: the wall display also comes in a small and a big version (CardDisplayWallSmall, CardDisplayBigWall)

steps.do: Check what the display shows of a card before you trust the front.
steps.because: the display holds a front object and a back object of its own (CardUI, m_CardFront, m_CardBack)

steps.do: Attach the price to the thing the tag can sit on.
steps.because: price tags are shipped per thing they can sit on, including a card (UI_PriceTagCard_Grp)

steps.do: Expect the display to simplify itself at a distance.
steps.because: it can cull parts at a distance with lists of objects to hide (m_FarDistanceCullObjList)

commonMistakes: Buying an electronic display before there are cards worth showing on it.
Putting the best cards in the cheapest case.
Pricing the card and forgetting that the tag belongs to the display.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
